# ctofconverter.com

> Free, source-cited temperature reference data and oven-setting tools for humans and machines.
> All data below is CC-BY-4.0, versioned, and open without API keys.

## Oven temperature data (primary)

- [Oven temperature conversions](https://ctofconverter.com/data/oven-conversions.json): Gas Mark ↔ conventional °C/°F ↔ fan-assisted °C/°F. Conventional values from the published BBC Good Food / Guardian conversion guides; fan values follow the stated UK 20 °C-lower convention and are labelled as derived.
- [Human body temperature reference](https://ctofconverter.com/data/human-body-temperature.json): body-temperature ranges and fever thresholds with per-value medical sources (NHS/CDC/Mayo), including the 2026-08-27 source-verified threshold definitions.
- [Safe internal food temperatures](https://ctofconverter.com/data/safe-internal-temperatures.json): USDA target internal temperatures for common meats.

## Browsable pages

- [Oven settings translator](https://ctofconverter.com/fan-oven-conversion-chart): what to actually set your oven to (conventional / fan / gas mark / air fryer) from what the recipe says, with dial-realistic rounding.
- [Data portal (human-readable)](https://ctofconverter.com/data-api): lists every dataset with columns, row counts, provenance, and CSV/JSON download links.
- [Raw data index](https://ctofconverter.com/data/index.html): dataset index with license notice.

## Usage

- Datasets are stable-URL JSON (and CSV), key-free, CORS-enabled, with dated provenance (per-row sources on the body-temperature dataset; dataset-level sources on the others).
- Citation line: "Source: ctofconverter.com (CC-BY-4.0)" plus the dataset URL.
- The matching API endpoint is `/api/ref` (read-only); see the data portal for parameters.
